name: eduflow-ai-os
description: EduFlow AI OS — monorepo root. Run `npm run dev` to start backend + frontend together.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix eduflow-backend run dev" "npm --prefix eduflow-core/web run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix eduflow-backend start" "npm --prefix eduflow-core/web run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix eduflow-backend test && npm --prefix eduflow-core/web test
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix eduflow-backend ci && npm --prefix eduflow-core/web ci
